notes.title: Full Release - Major Changes and Added Features
notes.notes:
Plantasia Full Release: Bedroom Decor, Seed Shuffler, Store and Database, and Gene Traits




Hey there! Thank you for playing our cozy game! The release of Plantasia 1.0 is a moment filled with emotion and gratitude to both our mentors and all of you, the people who made this game happen. It’s extremely rewarding to see what we have achieved as an all-volunteer team for our first released game.


The Full Release includes several new and exciting features: decorate your bedroom, buy and shuffle seeds, have an overview of your seed database, along with several improvements to the existing version.



Check out the full release notes below!



Full Release Overview
Decorate your bedroom with craftable decor available in 4 color schemes

Discover new seeds using the Seed Shuffler

Purchase more of the already discovered seeds in the Seed Store

Keep track of your discovered plant families, species, and colors in the Seed Database

Grow plants faster with newly added Affixes - gene traits that are more frequently encountered during the growth phase

Discover new Quests to get used to the game’s mechanics

Filter and sort through your Inventory for easier seed selection

And more improvements to already existing features




MAC BUILD COMING VERY SOON

Full Soundtrack now available for purchase through Steam!



ALERT:

It is highly recommended that all players clear their existing Save Data after updating the game to 1.0. If you choose to not clear your Save Data you may experience bugs the developers did not intend. We understand that you may have put a lot of hours and work into the game and may not want to delete that progress, but we strongly believe your experience will be much improved by starting fresh. We are unlikely to be able to fix bugs that occur due to uncleared data.



Decorate Your Bedroom
A new room has been added to the Greenhouse! Relax in style in your new and completely customizable Bedroom.

Unlock decor in your bedroom by crafting. Use the resources you collect while growing plants and create a cozy bedroom in different color schemes.

Decor can be crafted using the Crafting Table. Each crafting recipe shows what kind of resources you still need and what you have in your inventory. 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45292466/ec2176187d68942c3b575f38991754a2ee8603b0.png"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45292466/0b45422e9a043711e8b3fd18592036d4f512908d.png"]


Seed Bank: Complete your Seed Database
The Seed Bank is now open for use! One of the functionalities you can use with this addition is the Seed Database. Here, you can see which plants you have discovered, which plants are unknown, and details about the plant species and gene traits.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45292466/4ccf69de2ae7ba83d90c9107a755ff2da29e5514.png"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45292466/88652dc4ec179c789701219774908821dee4ab15.png"]


Seed Bank: Purchase Seeds in the Seed Store
The second tab in the Seed Bank is a Seed Store. Use the newly added currency to buy seeds of a specific species that you have already unlocked. Undiscovered seeds aren’t available for purchase.


Seed Bank: The Seed Shuffler
The seed shuffler is a scientific device that shuffles seed DNA to create new types of seeds. Use in game currency to power the device and if you are lucky you may unlock never before discovered seeds. The shuffler is also great for discovering new or improved Gene Traits.


Gene Traits
Plants now have Gene Traits – traits that change many aspects of the seeds growth, output or needs. You can view all Gene Traits in the Seed Database. Cross-breeding plants will also take Gene Traits into account. Gene Traits are a high level mechanic, and intended for players who want to deeply customize their growing experience. Casual players do not need to interact with this system in order to achieve their goals.


Revamped Tutorials 
Almost all tutorials have been reworked and put into an all-new quest format. Come along as B.E.A.R. teaches you the ins and outs of GARDEN Station systems with the help of the other REVIVE representatives. All Quests are “play at your own pace” and must be triggered by the player. This allows players to move through the story as slowly or quickly as they would like.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45292466/505e5e74711d92853fc435e8e0d93a561b70ddd0.png"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45292466/139454bb438353b7a58bc0d7f2eacc062f53d47f.png"]
Filter and Sort Seeds in Your Inventory
Looking for specific plants to grow? Use the newly added filters and sorting options! Sorting allows you to see seeds you currently own based on when they were discovered, alphabetically, by gene traits, tiers, colors and types. Multiple filters can be selected for a plant’s base, bloom, color or gene trait. Once you have selected all your desired traits, apply your selection and click on the window title again to close it.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45292466/2662c66d6612aaa2e375f5a4407cf55710c96a30.png"]
Complete Requests and Earn Resources
Requests from REVIVE have been moved to the top right corner. Click on the clipboard icon to see your active requests, then click on the request you’d like to complete and select the seeds you wish. Now that the Seed Store exists, Requests will no longer award seeds upon completion.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45292466/12ab0403ebd8ff335ac53d661c93791871eb53fe.png"]
On the future of Plantasia
First and foremost, Cave Bear Games is an all-volunteer studio by and for juniors looking to break into the game dev industry (and some of us now have!).

But what does that have to do with Plantasia?
Well, it means that a lot of the team will be focused on following the studio’s main goal: providing a space for junior devs and designers to flex their muscles and hone their craft. Plantasia is, for all purposes, a complete and released game now.


Does that mean Plantasia won’t receive any more updates?
Not necessarily. However, due to the nature of volunteer projects, any following updates will likely be minor bug fixes from the members who have the time to do so.



We want to thank everyone who supported us and believed in us throughout Plantasia’s development, and all the people who made this possible. A big thank you as well to all the mentors who were by our team's side and all our playtesters who made the game better. 



And finally, a thank you to you for playing our game and giving us a chance. We hope that this game helps you escape the chaos of daily life and provides a cozy respite, if only for a moment.




- The Cave Bear Team

notes.title: Update 1.0.0d
notes.notes:
Changelog:


     Added 95 new plants
     Modified all plant seed growth and drop rates to reflect early access timing
     Changed the start menu to say "Early Access" instead of "Demo"
     Removed the pop-up blurb explaining that growth times are reduced for demo purposes
     Fixed a major bug that would prevent the player inventory from resetting correctly after wiping data
     Added subtyping frames and new icons
     Added Reroll button for final alchemy card
     Added Reroll feedback via particles
     Inventory now closes when moving to a new room
     Changed text in main game scene to say Plantasia Early Access instead of Demo
     Fixed taskbar making the game go off the screen when adjusting window size
     Added unique dialogue sound effects for each character
     Adjusted the layout of the request board UI
     Minor animation bug fixes for dialogue boxes
     Added progression gates to prevent interaction with systems that haven't been introduced
     Revised all dialogue for better pacing
     Fixed base resource drops
     Hide plant info if the seed is not known from inventory menu
     Fixed seed info icon aspect ratio to fit with new seed size
     Added 2 seeds with a 30% chance to drop 3 on a harvest
     Reworked UI for the audio information in top right
     Added hover states for status icons on planters
     Fixed scroll bar on inventory being disabled
     Readjusted arrow sizes and spacing for inventory tab menu
     Added hover effects to the Play and Reset Data buttons on the Start Menu
     Adjusted the text box widths for characters so they don't overlap with the UI background elements
     Fixed cannot hit Play from the main menu after going back from the main game scene
     Players can now scroll the tab bar at the top of their inventory using the mouse wheel
     Expanded the yellow border around the reroll confirmation panel for the REVIVE requests
     Made the "Turn Off the Lights" screen reflect the new three starter planters instead of six
     Changed layout of music information in top right corner
     Decreased grow times for all plants

notes.title: Demo Patch Notes #3
notes.notes:
We have a new patch update for our demo! Thank you for continuing to support us by playtesting and leaving feedback! As always, please join our Discord to give us your notes, questions, concerns, and ideas in our #community-feedback channel!


 Cleaned up tutorial bugs (repeating dialogue, general code tidiness for tutorial manager)
 Imported larger UI for dialogue
 Quit button text changed and added a main menu button
 Dialogue box font changed
 Added ambience soundtrack
 Added door transitions
 Fixed parallax background
 Fixed bugs around refreshing multiple quests at the request board
 Fixed bug with seed rewards not being granted occasionally

notes.title: Demo Patch Notes #2 - 0.8.9.2
notes.notes:
Steam Next Fest is at an end - but Plantasia is only beginning! We have received lots of community feedback about bugs, questions, and new features. We are committed to improving the Demo alongside the full game throughout development, and the Demo will remain live permanently.

Plantasia goes into Early Access in late March - so stay tuned!


 options menu anchor fixed
 Seed Bundle Request menu should work more smoothly
 Seed Bundle Requests no longer require specific plant colors without telling us
 Seed Colors are now present in the Seed Bundle Allocation menu
 Seed Bundle Alocation menus now close automatically when opening another Allocation menu
 Fixed MacKenna's dialogue after completing the first Seed Bundle Request
 Made good progress on stopping the Request Menu from crashing out when you complete one (not done yet but much closer)
 Removed console box that popped up in background for some machines
 Removed dev log that popped after planting seeds


We are still working on a number of improvements daily! If you encounter bugs or have general feedback, please join our Discord and post your suggestions in the #community-feedback channel. Our developers are very active and can update you on upcoming changes.

Please join us this afternoon our Discord for a short Livestream with our Creative Director, Ayla to go over the newest updates. 3pm PST, March 3rd!

notes.title: Demo Patch Notes #1 - 0.8.9.1
notes.notes:
Thank you for playing Plantasia during the first three days of Steam Next Fest! We have received lots of community feedback about bugs, questions, and new features. We are committed to improving the Demo alongside the full game throughout development - but certainly during Next Fest. 


New Features:

 Made seed bank spin on loop in the seed bank
 Added particle effect around plants when ready to harvest


What has been fixed?

 Fixed scaling issues appearing on screens other than 1920x1080. All screens, including ultra wides, should fit Plantasia normally.
 Fixed an issue where seed in the inventory appeared outside the inventory box after scrolling
 Reduced the number of times a plant will generate a Growth Trigger 
 fixed an issue where plants in pots were not saved when closing and reopening Plantasia
 Max inventory count is now removed
 Fixed sub filtering on greenhouse and seed request inventories
 Redid seed bank room completely to work with the widescreen change
 Seed Bundle Request system refresh fixes and changes
 Plants planted in a planter not loading from save images fixed (new plants only)
 Multiple minor Adjustments to request bundle (grid layout, autoselect/deselect)
 No more spamming rewards from the Seed Bundle Requests
 Patched bug where inventory UI wasn't updating when a request was completed
 UI adjustments to NPC Dialogue (response highlighted buttons brightened)


We are still working on a number of improvements daily! If you encounter bugs or have general feedback, please join our Discord and post your suggestions in the #community-feedback channel. Our developers are very active and can update you on upcoming changes.

Please join us tonight on the Steam Page or in our Discord for a Live Birthday Stream with our Creative Director, Ayla at 6pm PST, February 26th!
